clauses.heading: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 0.45 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: Bidders must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 0.45 lakh over the last 3 financial years.

clauses.heading: Years of Past Experience Required
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: Bidders must have 3 years of past experience in same or similar service.

clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No MSE relaxation is given for turnover requirements.

clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No MSE relaxation is given for experience requirements.

clauses.heading: Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No startup relaxation is given for turnover requirements.

clauses.heading: Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No startup relaxation is given for experience requirements.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Document required from seller Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Additional Doc 1 (Requested in ATC)
clauses.summary: Sellers must upload experience criteria, past performance and bidder turnover documents.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Document required from seller Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Additional Doc 1 (Requested in ATC)
clauses.summary: Sellers must upload bidder turnover documents with the bid.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: EMD Detail U /Required No /ePBG Detail Q /Advisory Bank State Bank of India
clauses.summary: No EMD is required for this bid.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate showing turnover must be uploaded.

clauses.heading: 2. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the bid {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: The bidder or its OEM must have regularly supplied similar products to government bodies or PSUs for the stated number of years.

clauses.heading: 2. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates for each financial year must be submitted as proof of experience.

clauses.heading: 4. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 30% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: The bidder or its OEM must have supplied at least 30% of the bid quantity in one of the last three financial years to government bodies or PSUs.
